steps.title: Part 0 Step 1: стенд — устройства топологии (сетевые пространства имён)
steps.cmd: ip netns list

steps.title: Part 0 Step 2: стенд — IPv4-адреса устройств (таблица адресации)
steps.cmd: for d in $(ip netns list | cut -d' ' -f1); do echo "== $d"; sudo ip -n $d -4 -br addr show up; done

steps.title: Part 0 Step 3: рабочий каталог (диски PC-A и PC-B)
steps.cmd: cd ~/labs/devnet-src/pt-protocols && ls -lR

steps.title: Part 1 Step 1: DNS-служба сервера Corporate (запись www.example.com)
steps.content:
# Corporate > Services > DNS: DNS Service On
# Name: www.example.com, Address: 64.100.0.10 (A Record), Add
port=53
listen-address=192.168.1.3
bind-interfaces
no-resolv
no-hosts
host-record=www.example.com,64.100.0.10
log-queries
pid-file

steps.title: Part 1 Step 1: файл настройки DNS сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: cat /etc/dnsmasq.d/Corporate-dns.conf

steps.title: Part 1 Step 1d: включение службы DNS на Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate dnsmasq -C /etc/dnsmasq.d/Corporate-dns.conf

steps.title: Part 1 Step 1g: запись www.example.com на DNS-сервере Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate dig @192.168.1.3 www.example.com +noall +answer

steps.title: Part 1 Step 2a: текущая (статическая) IP-конфигурация PC-A
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ip -4 addr show eth0

steps.title: Part 1 Step 2c: DNS Server 192.168.1.3 на PC-A
Part 1 Step 2c: resolv.conf PC-A
steps.cmd: cat /etc/netns/PC-A/resolv.conf

steps.title: Part 1 Step 2e: ping www.example.com с PC-A
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ping -c 4 www.example.com

steps.title: Part 1 Step 2e: запросы PC-A в журнале DNS-сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo journalctl -t dnsmasq -o cat --no-pager -g 'from 192.168.1.2'

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3: DNS-служба Example Server (настроена заранее)
steps.cmd: cat /etc/dnsmasq.d/Example-Server-dns.conf

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3c: DNS Server 64.100.0.10 на PC-B
Part 1 Step 3c: resolv.conf PC-B
steps.cmd: cat /etc/netns/PC-B/resolv.conf

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3e: ping www.example.com с PC-B
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B ping -c 4 www.example.com

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3f: ping www.devasc-netacad.pka с PC-B
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B ping -c 4 www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3h: страница www.example.com (браузер PC-B)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -i http://www.example.com

steps.title: Part 1 Step 3i: страница www.devasc-netacad.pka (браузер PC-B)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -i http://www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 2 Step 1: DHCP-служба Corporate, пул serverPool
steps.content:
# Corporate > Services > DHCP: Service On, Pool Name serverPool
port=0
interface=eth0
dhcp-authoritative
dhcp-sequential-ip
# Start IP Address 192.168.1.10, Subnet Mask 255.255.255.0, Maximum number of users 245
dhcp-range=set:serverPool,192.168.1.10,192.168.1.254,255.255.255.0,24h
dhcp-lease-max=245
# Default Gateway 192.168.1.1, DNS Server 192.168.1.3
dhcp-option=tag:serverPool,option:router,192.168.1.1
dhcp-option=tag:serverPool,option:dns-server,192.168.1.3
dhcp-leasefile=/var/lib/misc/dnsmasq.leases
log-dhcp
pid-file

steps.title: Part 2 Step 1d-i: файл настройки DHCP сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: cat /etc/dnsmasq.d/Corporate-dhcp.conf

steps.title: Part 2 Step 1c, 1j: включение службы DHCP (Save)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate dnsmasq -C /etc/dnsmasq.d/Corporate-dhcp.conf

steps.title: Part 2 Step 1: службы DNS (53) и DHCP (67) на Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate ss -ulpn

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2d: PC-A — отказ от статического адреса
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ip addr flush dev eth0

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2d: PC-A — получение адреса по DHCP
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A busybox udhcpc -i eth0 -fqn -t 5 -x hostname:PC-A -s /opt/labnet/dhcp.sh

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2: адрес PC-A, полученный по DHCP
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ip -4 addr show eth0

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2: шлюз по умолчанию PC-A
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ip route

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2: DNS-сервер PC-A
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A cat /etc/resolv.conf

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2: аренда в базе DHCP-сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo cat /var/lib/misc/dnsmasq.leases

steps.title: Part 2 Step 2: обмен DHCP в журнале сервера
steps.cmd: sudo journalctl -t dnsmasq-dhcp -o cat --no-pager -g 'DHCP(DISCOVER|OFFER|REQUEST|ACK)'

steps.title: Part 3 Step 1: NTP-служба сервера Corporate
steps.content:
# Corporate > Services > NTP: Service On
# Внешнего источника времени нет: сервер сам служит эталоном для сети 192.168.1.0/24
local stratum 8
allow 192.168.1.0/24
bindaddress 192.168.1.3
bindcmdaddress 127.0.0.1
bindcmdaddress /run/chrony/Corporate.sock
pidfile /run/chrony/Corporate.pid

steps.title: Part 3 Step 1: файл настройки NTP сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: cat /etc/chrony/Corporate-chrony.conf

steps.title: Part 3 Step 1d: включение службы NTP (chronyd)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate chronyd -4 -x -f /etc/chrony/Corporate-chrony.conf

steps.title: Part 3 Step 1: состояние NTP-сервера
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate chronyc -h 127.0.0.1 tracking

steps.title: Part 3 Step 1: сервер NTP слушает UDP 123
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate ss -ulpn 'sport = :123'

steps.title: Part 3 Step 2a-f: консоль S2 — enable, show clock detail, ntp server 192.168.1.3
steps.cmd: sudo pt-console S2

steps.title: Part 3 Step 2f: S2 (192.168.1.4) среди клиентов NTP-сервера
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate chronyc -h /run/chrony/Corporate.sock -n clients

steps.title: Part 3 Step 2f: журнал эмулятора S2 — синхронизация по NTP
steps.cmd: sudo grep -E 'ntp|NTP' /var/log/pt-lab/S2.log

steps.title: Part 4 Step c: Telnet с PC-A на S2 (отклоняется)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A telnet 192.168.1.4

steps.title: Part 4 Step d: справка по команде ssh
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ssh

steps.title: Part 4 Step e-f: SSH с PC-A на S2, enable, exit
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ssh -l administrator 192.168.1.4

steps.title: Part 4: журнал эмулятора S2 — Telnet отклонён, сессия SSH
steps.cmd: sudo grep -E 'telnet|SSH|enable' /var/log/pt-lab/S2.log

steps.title: Part 5: SNMP-агент R3 и community-строки read/write (настроены заранее)
steps.cmd: cat /etc/snmp/R3-snmpd.conf

steps.title: Part 5 Step c-n: дерево .mgmt.mib-2.system на R3 (community read)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B snmpwalk -v2c -c read 172.16.3.1 1.3.6.1.2.1.1

steps.title: Part 5 Step o-p: GET .sysName.0
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B snmpget -v2c -c read 172.16.3.1 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0

steps.title: Part 5 Step q: интерфейсы R3 (.ifTable.ifEntry.ifDescr)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B snmpwalk -v2c -c read 172.16.3.1 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.2

steps.title: Part 5 Step q: состояние интерфейсов R3 (.ifTable.ifEntry.ifOperStatus)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B snmpwalk -v2c -c read 172.16.3.1 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8

steps.title: Part 6 Step 1d: www.devasc-netacad.pka открывается по HTTP
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -sI http://www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 6 Step 2e: правила FIREWALL, список доступа OUTSIDE-DMZ
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec FIREWALL iptables -S

steps.title: Part 6 Step 2e: статический NAT 192.168.2.3 <-> 209.165.200.227 на FIREWALL
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec FIREWALL iptables -t nat -S

steps.title: Part 6 Step 2g: удаление разрешения HTTP (порт 80) из OUTSIDE-DMZ
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec FIREWALL iptables -D OUTSIDE-DMZ -d 192.168.2.3/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT

steps.title: Part 6 Step 2g: OUTSIDE-DMZ после изменения
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec FIREWALL iptables -S OUTSIDE-DMZ

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3b: веб-сервер DEVASC Server — HTTP On, HTTPS Off
steps.cmd: cat /etc/nginx/DEVASC-Server.conf

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: каталог DEVASC-Server
steps.cmd: cd DEVASC-Server

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: закрытый ключ сервера
steps.cmd: openssl genrsa -out devasc.key 2048

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: самоподписанный сертификат www.devasc-netacad.pka
steps.cmd: openssl req -new -x509 -key devasc.key -out devasc.crt -subj /CN=www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: параметры сертификата
steps.cmd: openssl x509 -in devasc.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3c-d: HTTP Off, HTTPS On
Part 6 Step 3c-d: новый файл настройки веб-сервера
steps.cmd: cat /etc/nginx/DEVASC-Server.conf

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: проверка синтаксиса
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec DEVASC-Server nginx -t -c /etc/nginx/DEVASC-Server.conf

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: применение настройки
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec DEVASC-Server nginx -s reload -c /etc/nginx/DEVASC-Server.conf

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: DEVASC Server слушает только 443
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec DEVASC-Server ss -tlnp

steps.title: Part 6 Step 3: возврат в рабочий каталог
steps.cmd: cd ..

steps.title: Part 6 Step 4c: http://www.devasc-netacad.pka — Request Timeout
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -m 10 http://www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 6 Step 4d: https://www.devasc-netacad.pka
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -vk https://www.devasc-netacad.pka

steps.title: Part 7 Step 1: служба EMAIL Example Server — SMTP и POP3, домен
steps.content:
# Example Server > Services > EMAIL
[email]
smtp = on
pop3 = on
domain = www.example.com
address = 64.100.0.10

[users]

steps.title: Part 7 Step 1d-f: SMTP On, POP3 On, Domain Name www.example.com
steps.cmd: cat /etc/labnet/Example-Server-email.ini

steps.title: Part 7 Step 2: пользователи Student1 и Student2
steps.content:
# Example Server > Services > EMAIL
[email]
smtp = on
pop3 = on
domain = www.example.com
address = 64.100.0.10

[users]
Student1 = class
Student2 = class

steps.title: Part 7 Step 2a-d: пользователи почтового сервера
steps.cmd: cat /etc/labnet/Example-Server-email.ini

steps.title: Part 7 Step 2: запуск службы EMAIL на Example Server
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Example-Server python3 /opt/labnet/email_server.py -c /etc/labnet/Example-Server-email.ini --daemon

steps.title: Part 7 Step 2: порты SMTP (25) и POP3 (110)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Example-Server ss -tlnp

steps.title: Part 7 Step 3a-e: почтовый клиент PC-A (Student1, сервер 64.100.0.10)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A curl -v -u Student1:class pop3://64.100.0.10/

steps.title: Part 7 Step 3f: почтовый клиент PC-B (Student2, сервер 64.100.0.10)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -v -u Student2:class pop3://64.100.0.10/

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4a: PC-B
steps.cmd: cd PC-B

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4b-c: письмо Student1 (Compose)
steps.content:
From: Student2 <Student2@www.example.com>
To: Student1@www.example.com
Subject: Email
Message-ID: <pcb-email-1@www.example.com>
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

How are you?

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4c: текст письма
steps.cmd: cat email-to-Student1.eml

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4d: отправка письма по SMTP (Send)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -v --crlf -T email-to-Student1.eml smtp://64.100.0.10/PC-B --mail-from Student2@www.example.com --mail-rcpt Student1@www.example.com

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4e: PC-A
steps.cmd: cd ../PC-A

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4f: получение почты по POP3 (Receive)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A curl -u Student1:class pop3://64.100.0.10/

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4g: чтение письма
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A curl -u Student1:class pop3://64.100.0.10/1

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4h-i: ответ Student2 (Reply)
steps.content:
From: Student1 <Student1@www.example.com>
To: Student2@www.example.com
Subject: Re: Email
In-Reply-To: <pcb-email-1@www.example.com>
References: <pcb-email-1@www.example.com>
Message-ID: <pca-reply-1@www.example.com>
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

I'm fine, thank you!

> How are you?

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4i: текст ответа
steps.cmd: cat reply-to-Student2.eml

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4j: отправка ответа (Send)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A curl -v --crlf -T reply-to-Student2.eml smtp://64.100.0.10/PC-A --mail-from Student1@www.example.com --mail-rcpt Student2@www.example.com

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4k: PC-B
steps.cmd: cd ../PC-B

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4k: получение ответа (Receive)
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -u Student2:class pop3://64.100.0.10/

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4k: чтение ответа
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-B curl -u Student2:class pop3://64.100.0.10/1

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4: журнал почтового сервера
steps.cmd: sudo cat /var/log/pt-lab/email.log

steps.title: Part 7 Step 4: возврат в рабочий каталог
steps.cmd: cd ..

steps.title: Part 8 Step 1: FTP-служба Corporate, пользователь Student
steps.content:
# Corporate > Services > FTP: Service On
[ftp]
service = on
address = 192.168.1.3
root = /srv/labnet/Corporate/ftp
banner = Welcome to Corporate FTP server

# Username: Student, Password: class; Write, Read, Delete, Rename, List; Add
[user Student]
password = class
permissions = write, read, delete, rename, list

steps.title: Part 8 Step 1e-g: файл настройки FTP сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: cat /etc/labnet/Corporate-ftp.ini

steps.title: Part 8 Step 1d, 1h: включение службы FTP
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec Corporate python3 /opt/labnet/ftp_server.py -c /etc/labnet/Corporate-ftp.ini --daemon

steps.title: Part 8 Step 2a-c: PC-A
steps.cmd: cd PC-A

steps.title: Part 8 Step 2d: файлы на PC-A (dir)
steps.cmd: ls -l

steps.title: Part 8 Step 2e-m: сеанс FTP с PC-A на Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo ip netns exec PC-A ftp 192.168.1.3

steps.title: Part 8 Step 2n: файлы на PC-A после сеанса FTP (dir)
steps.cmd: ls -l

steps.title: Part 8 Step 2: журнал FTP-сервера Corporate
steps.cmd: sudo cat /var/log/pt-lab/ftp.log
